output.headerText:
OR3 SSR Auth + can() Authorization — Security Audit Pack

Scope: Session resolution, can()/capability gates, token broker, admin auth hardening, workspace membership APIs, lock-page gating, client session recovery, related docs/tests.

Primary surfaces:
1. server/auth/can.ts + capability-gate — sole authorization gate for SSR endpoints
2. server/auth/session.ts + /api/auth/session — session resolution / identity split (internal user id vs providerUserId)
3. server/auth/token-broker — direct-provider JWT templates
4. server/admin/auth + guard — admin login, rate limits, trusted client identity
5. server/api/workspaces — membership / active workspace switching
6. app/composables/auth + session refresh plugins — client trust boundary
7. app/core/lock-page — pre-auth lock surface

Excluded: OpenRouter LLM proxy/background jobs (separate pack), sync/storage engines (separate packs), plugin runtime, themes, webhooks, Convex provider package internals.
